data.value: Complete guide to help you get started and master MiniJira task management

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.1.Intro
data.value: When you first open MiniJira, you'll see the user selection screen. This allows you to choose which user you want to work as.

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.1.Step1.Text
data.value: Choose your user from the available options. Each user can have different tasks assigned to them.

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.1.Step1.Caption
data.value: User Selection Screen - Choose your user to continue

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.1.NoteText
data.value: This is a mock authentication system for demonstration purposes. In a production environment, you would use proper authentication.

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.2.Intro
data.value: After selecting your user, you'll see the main task board. This is where you'll spend most of your time managing tasks.

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.2.Caption
data.value: Main Dashboard - Your task management center

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.2.Feature1.Text
data.value: View all your tasks organized by columns (ToDo, InProgress, Done)

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.2.Feature2.Text
data.value: Quickly add new tasks with the "Create Task" button

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.2.Feature3.Text
data.value: Find tasks quickly using filters and search

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.2.Feature4.Text
data.value: Move tasks between columns by dragging them

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.3.Intro
data.value: The sidebar on the left provides access to all major features of MiniJira.

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.3.Development.HiddenTasksDesc
data.value: View tasks you've hidden from the main board

data.name: UserGuide.Section1.3.Settings.SettingsDesc
data.value: Customize language, font size, and color palette

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.1.Intro
data.value: Creating tasks in MiniJira is quick and easy. Follow these steps:

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.1.Step1.Text
data.value: From the main dashboard, click the "Create Task" button in the top right corner.

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.1.Step1.Caption
data.value: Click the Create Task button to begin

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.1.Step2.Text
data.value: Enter the task information in the create task form:

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.1.Step2.Field3Desc
data.value: Who should work on this task

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.1.Step3.Text
data.value: Click the "Create" or "Save" button to add the task to your board.

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.1.Step3.SuccessText
data.value: Your task will appear on the board in the selected column.

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.2.Intro
data.value: Click on any task card to view its full details, comments, attachments, and history.

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.2.Caption
data.value: Task Detail View - See all task information

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.2.Feature1.Text
data.value: View title, description, assignee, status, and priority

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.2.Feature2.Text
data.value: Add and view comments for collaboration

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.2.Feature3.Text
data.value: Upload and download files related to the task

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.2.Feature4.Text
data.value: Track changes and updates to the task

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.3.Intro
data.value: You can modify any task by opening its details and clicking the "Edit" button.

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.3.StepList1
data.value: Click on a task card to open the details view

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.3.StepList3
data.value: Modify the fields you want to change

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.4.Intro
data.value: MiniJira supports drag-and-drop to move tasks through your workflow.

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.4.Caption
data.value: Drag tasks between columns to update their status

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.4.StepList1
data.value: Click and hold on a task card

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.4.StepList2
data.value: Drag the card to the desired column

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.4.StepList3
data.value: Release the mouse button to drop the task

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.4.StepList4
data.value: The task's status is automatically updated

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.5.Intro
data.value: You can hide tasks from the main board to reduce clutter without deleting them.

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.5.Caption
data.value: Hide tasks to clean up your board

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.5.Hide.Step3
data.value: The task disappears from the main board

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.5.Show.Step3
data.value: Click "Show" to restore a task to the board

data.name: UserGuide.Section2.6.WarningText
data.value: Deleting a task is permanent and cannot be undone. Consider hiding the task instead.

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.1.Intro
data.value: Columns represent different stages in your workflow. By default, MiniJira includes three system columns:

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.1.ToDo.Text
data.value: Tasks that need to be started. This is where new tasks typically begin.

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.1.InProgress.Text
data.value: Tasks currently being worked on. Move tasks here when you start working on them.

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.1.Done.Text
data.value: Completed tasks. Move tasks here when they're finished.

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.1.NoteText
data.value: System columns (ToDo, InProgress, Done) cannot be deleted, but you can create custom columns for your specific workflow.

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.2.Intro
data.value: Use the column filter to view tasks from specific columns only.

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.2.Caption
data.value: Filter tasks by column to focus on specific work

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.2.Step1
data.value: Look for the column filter dropdown

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.2.Step2
data.value: Select one or more columns to display

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.2.Step3
data.value: The board updates to show only tasks in selected columns

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.2.Step4
data.value: Select "All Columns" to see everything again

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.3.Intro
data.value: Administrators can create, edit, and delete custom columns to match their workflow.

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.3.Create.Step1
data.value: Navigate to "Column Management" in the sidebar

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.3.Create.Step3
data.value: Enter the column name and select a color

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.3.Create.Step4
data.value: Set the display order (position on the board)

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.3.Edit.Step1
data.value: Click the "Edit" button next to the column

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.3.Edit.Step2
data.value: Modify the name, color, or order

data.name: UserGuide.Section3.3.DeleteWarningText
data.value: You cannot delete a column that contains tasks. Move or delete all tasks first.
